history.administration_response: The Department of Operational Support reiterates that the decision of the Administration to enter a financial agreement was based on the memorandum of understanding between the Secretariat and the United Nations Office for Project Services. The procedures to assess and document whether such an agreement is appropriate is governed by that memorandum, as are the requirements for inclusion in the financial agreement.
history.board_assessment: The memorandum of understanding is being revised. The Board considers it crucial that guidance on the use of the memorandum also be enhanced. The recommendation has been overtaken by events.
